name: Sovereign Knowledge Compiler
summary: Compile-time memory for local-first AI agents. The reference implementation of The Sovereign Knowledge Compiler — it turns a corpus of human knowledge into structured semantic artifacts, then into a navigable decision graph, using only local inference.
problem: Query-time AI rediscovers the same relationships inside a knowledge base on every request. That repeated reasoning is expensive and does not compound.
why_matters: By compiling knowledge once, the hard interpretive work is done ahead of time and reused by everyone — directly lowering the cognitive cost of understanding a body of knowledge.
core_ideas: Compile human knowledge into progressively higher-level semantic artifacts
Compile-time memory: reasoning done once, explored many times
Fully local-first inference — no cloud calls, no external APIs
Produces both structured facts and an inspectable decision graph
Compounds on knowledge-compiler-sdk as its foundation
mission_context: This project explores one approach toward reducing the cost of understanding human knowledge by compiling a corpus into structured semantic artifacts and an inspectable decision graph — so the reasoning is done once, locally, and reused by every reader.

name: Knowledge Compiler SDK
summary: A Python SDK that compiles collections of human knowledge into progressively higher-level semantic artifacts — until they can generate deployable software. The foundation beneath the Sovereign Knowledge Compiler.
problem: Human knowledge lives in disconnected documents. Turning it into something a system (or a person) can reason over requires repeated, ad-hoc interpretation.
why_matters: The SDK makes knowledge compilation a reusable, programmable operation — the substrate that lets higher-level systems reduce the cost of understanding at scale.
core_ideas: Progressive compilation: raw text to structured artifacts to higher-level semantic layers
Knowledge as a compilable artifact, not just retrievable text
Reusable SDK consumed by the Sovereign Knowledge Compiler
mission_context: This project explores one approach toward reducing the cost of understanding human knowledge by providing a programmable SDK that compiles collections of documents into progressively higher-level semantic artifacts — organizing knowledge before the question is ever asked.

name: sovereign-intelligence-stack
summary: The canonical 5-layer sovereign intelligence architecture: recipe compiler, signal router, autonomous evaluation, apprenticeship engine, and intelligence observatory.
problem: AI systems lack the structural coherence to operate autonomously with sovereignty. Individual components exist but don't form a unified system.
why_matters: This is the complete architecture that ties everything together — from local inference to autonomous evaluation to observability.
core_ideas: Recipe-based development: specifications as executable artifacts
Signal routing: dynamic dispatch based on task complexity
Autonomous evaluation: systems that judge their own output
Apprenticeship learning: agents learn from their own mistakes
Observability: tracking intelligence across its lifecycle
mission_context: This project explores one approach toward reducing the cost of understanding human knowledge by the canonical 5-layer sovereign intelligence architecture: recipe compiler, signal router, autonomous evaluation, apprenticeship engine, and intelligence observatory.
